guide.text: Conner Kent's signature gear. Its universal skill increases Energy gain and grants a significant Attack bonus to allies. Its exclusive skill increases Effect Resistance, and at max level can freeze enemies at the start of battle, turning Conner into a powerful Supporter who excels at both damage boosting and control.
